name: Arzew–Canvey liquefied natural gas supply
description: Liquefied natural gas shipments connected Algeria to a British receiving terminal and distribution network.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: A commercial LNG cargo arrived at Canvey Island in October 1964.

evidence.supports: National Gas reports a 1959 trial, commercial LNG arrival at Canvey in October 1964 and regular imports; a 200 km pipeline linked the terminal to eight area boards.

events.caveats: The earlier 1959 trial is distinct; arrival does not by itself establish retail access to unconverted natural gas.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: A local account dates an Arzew–Canvey cargo to 12 October and reports its size as 12,000 tonnes.

evidence.supports: A local historical account reports a 12 October 1964 cargo of 12,000 tonnes from Arzew and describes the terminal and pipeline; it does not name the ship carrying that cargo.

events.caveats: The retrospective account does not name the ship carrying this cargo.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest event for this scoped capability established by the inspected passages; no global priority is inferred.

research.note: Source-backed admission; independent review pending. Independent reader checked the dated events and marked measures against the cited sources.

unresolved.note: The 1959 American-to-Canvey trial preceded the commercial service, but no exact trial shipment is represented separately.
